falsifier: Any MWCC 1.2.5 build in which (1) a plain pointer-chase EXPRESSION emits `lwz r12,<n>(rThis)` for the INTERMEDIATE vtable word; or (3a) a class with virtual functions is measured putting its vptr at offset 0 rather than after its declared data; or (3b) a virtual dispatch displacement is measured at anything other than 8 + 4*slot; or (3c) a class with only DECLARED, never-defined virtuals emits a `__vt__` symbol into the object (check with `powerpc-eabi-nm` / `objdump -t`); or (4) a C-mode caller is measured NOT inlining a `static inline` helper defined in a cplusplus-on region of the same TU. Re-derive the whole law with `python tools/gdl/fnasm.py game/movie/movieplayer fn_800D967C --diff --raw` and `python tools/gdl/composed_census/wf_word_diff.py game/movie/movieplayer fn_800D967C` (0 differing words at HEAD 443785f05), and the same pair on fn_800DA60C.
subject: compiler:mwcc-gc-1.2.5
value:
MWCC GC 1.2.5, -O4, inside a `#pragma cplusplus on` region of a mixed C/C++ TU. FOUR clauses, all measured this run on game/movie/movieplayer.cpp, where they produced two source-exact closes that DELETED their WebFrank rules and one partial close.

(1) THE IDIOM, AND WHY IT READS AS A COLOURING PROBLEM. A C++ VIRTUAL CALL lowers to `lwz r12,<vptr>(rThis)` / `lwz r12,<slot>(r12)` / `mtlr r12` / `blrl`: the vtable pointer is loaded STRAIGHT INTO r12, the call-target register, and refined in place. A hand-written pointer chase over the same two words is compiled as an ordinary pointer expression and MWCC gives the intermediate an ordinary scratch. Verbatim at fn_800D967C, `fnasm --raw --diff`: @0xc target `lwz r12,32(r3)` against ours `lwz r6,32(r3)`; @0x14 target `lwz r12,12(r12)` against ours `lwz r12,12(r6)`; @0x1c and @0x20 both `mtlr r12` / `blrl`. THE TWO STREAMS DIFFER IN REGISTER FIELDS ONLY, so every arbiter reads REGISTER_ONLY / RECOLOR and wf_word_diff prints `DECODE: REGFIELD-ONLY 2 ... the only class a shipped rule reaches` -- which is how this shape twice acquired a copy_register_fields rule. IT IS SOURCE-REACHABLE. A register-field-only verdict is a statement about the ENCODING, never about the reachability of the construct behind it.

(2) NO EXPRESSION RESPELLING REACHES IT: measured NEUTRAL-IDENTICAL (object bytes unchanged) twice on fn_800D967C. (a) attempt.PP_fn800d967c-the-one-word-residual-is-the-mwcc-virtual-dispatch-idiom.20260903.v1 deleted the named function-pointer temporary and called the expression inline. (b) THIS RUN: splitting the chase into two assignments to ONE `register`-qualified function-pointer variable, so both loads would share a web and the call would force r12 onto it -- `dispatch = *(void (**)(int, u32, u32))(param_1 + 32);` then `dispatch = *(void (**)(int, u32, u32))((u32)dispatch + 12);` -- also folded away before codegen. The front end normalises both to the same IR. Only a real class with a real virtual moves the bytes.

(3) THE THREE LAYOUT FACTS THAT LET YOU WRITE THE CURE WITH NO VTABLE EVIDENCE AT ALL. (a) Metrowerks places the VPTR AFTER the class's data members, so a class declaring exactly N bytes of data puts its vptr at +N. That is what puts movieplayer's codec vptr at +0x20, and the target confirms it independently with `stw r0,32(this)` in both Codec destructors. (b) THE DISPATCH DISPLACEMENT IS `8 + 4*slot` -- an 8-byte vtable header precedes slot 0. Derived in ONE build: declaring the called method as the 4th virtual emitted `lwz r12,20(r12)` against the target's `lwz r12,12(r12)`, and 8+4*3 = 20 fixes the constant, so the target's 12 is slot 1 and 28 (fn_800DA60C) is slot 5 and 24 (fn_800DA6A4) is slot 4. (c) A class whose virtuals are DECLARED AND NEVER DEFINED emits NO vtable and NO RTTI into the object and links clean (full ninja green, `build/GUNE5D/main.dol: OK`, DATA row unchanged in `defake_gate check`). So the cure costs zero bytes of .data and needs no knowledge of the real class: declare only the slots this TU calls, pad the rest with placeholder `virtual void vN();`, and cast the object to it.

(4) THE C++-MODE COST, AND THE FORM THAT AVOIDS IT. The cure needs the caller inside `#pragma cplusplus on` with `extern "C"` to keep the unmangled symbol, and that switch also changes the caller's own semantics. Measured on fn_800DA6A4: `return frameIndex < frameCount;` became a bool and MWCC added a zero-extending `clrlwi r3,r0,24` at +0x20c, taking the function 159 -> 160 instructions (count parity is categorical, so this alone kills the edit); a `? TRUE : FALSE` respelling was WORSE (161, a branchy `li 1`/`b`/`li 0`); and `void*` returns stopped converting implicitly (two AllocHiMem sites, hard compile errors). THE FORM THAT WORKS: leave the caller in C mode and route the dispatch through a `static inline` C++ helper declared in the cplusplus-on region. MWCC inlines it ACROSS the language-mode boundary; fn_800DA6A4 returned to 159/159 with the two dispatch words exact. Prefer this whenever the caller carries a boolean return, an implicit void* conversion, or any other C-only construct.

MEASURED CLOSURES (game/movie/movieplayer.cpp, all raw pre-postprocess counts from `composed_census/wf_word_diff.py`): fn_800D967C 2 words -> 0, rule DELETED, EQUIVALENT -> STRICT; fn_800DA60C 3 words -> 0, rule DELETED, EQUIVALENT -> STRICT -- and that pin's own mechanism note had recorded the opposite conclusion, 'three distinct source spellings of the indirect vtable call all failed to make MWCC resolve the pointer in r12 at point of use', which is exactly the trap clause (2) explains: all three were EXPRESSIONS; fn_800DA6A4 14 words -> 12, the dispatch pair closed and the residual reduced to an unrelated callee-saved exchange. Image-wide the shape is findable without a build: look for a target `lwz r12,N(rX)` / `lwz r12,K(r12)` pair against ours `lwz rV,N(rX)` / `lwz r12,K(rV)`.
